claims.claim: pumpkinseed mature 1–2 yr earlier and > 20 mm smaller in winterkill ponds
claims.note: Abstract only. The abstract says that pumpkinseed in two shallow winterkill ponds matured '1–2 yr earlier and at a smaller size (difference > 20 mm in length)' than fish in an adjacent lake without winterkill (near Lake Opinicon, Ontario, per the Queen's University Biological Station's project record). Whether the 20 mm is total or standard length, and the sample sizes, need the full text.

claims.claim: ~35 mm TL size threshold for first-winter survival (via Sobchak et al. 2026)
claims.note: Abstract only. The abstract is about age and size at maturity after winterkill; it gives no size threshold for overwinter survival. Sobchak et al. 2026 cite 'Fox and Keast 1991; Garvey et al. 2002' together for the 35-mm figure (see Sobchak_etal_2026.json), so which of the two gives it is unknown.
